label: Some holder of a power for the actual contingents' joint absence has POWER_OVER_ESSE_1 over each
paraphrase: Some being exists at w, has at w a power for the joint absence of the concrete beings contingent at w, and has POWER_OVER_ESSE_1 over each concrete being contingent at w (the distributive powers, held by one being). It says nothing about the holder's necessity, concreteness or what decides the power's exercise.
